purpose: Research improvement test, not a relabeled untouched holdout or authority to deploy
auxiliary_outcome: equity_log_variance: observed within-month sum of centered daily log-return squares, never a known future trading signal
daily_forecast_clock: 21 synthetic sessions per forecast month; realized sessions counted explicitly; no future actual closure calendar is read before freezing
confirmation_scope: New forecast-evaluation intervals must not overlap the prior consumed forecast batches; all historical eras remain retrospective, human-known diagnostics, including already published historical counterfactual summaries. No claim of pristine human-independent history.
old_eras: The original 26 forecasts are immutable diagnostics only; no candidate promotion on their outcomes
missing_data: No macro interpolation or discontinuous historical blocks; preserve missing rows and exclude invalid transitions

convergence.scope: Sampling precision is separate from model validity; failed convergence remains failed, no path deletion
